fixes.explanation: Wheat is a solid guess, friend, because people plant it all the time. But Jesus doesn't go to the wheat field here. He says the kingdom of God "…is like a mustard seed that a man tossed into his garden." (Luke 13:19) Mustard, the tiny one. Wheat is sitting in the parking lot wondering why nobody called.

Beasts of the field is a fun guess, friend. But Jesus doesn't list them here. He says "…the birds of the air nested in its branches." (Luke 13:19) Nesting up in branches is bird business. I bet a beast trying to climb up there would make a lot of noise on the way.
